errors.description: The budget does not exist in the active clinic or has been deleted.
The item does not exist in the requested budget.
No acceptance signature exists for the budget.
The public token does not identify an available budget.
A signed public PDF is available only after the budget is accepted.
The patient does not exist in the active clinic.

errors.message: Professional not found in this clinic
errors.description: An assigned professional must belong to the active clinic.
Creating or sending a budget that requires patient data is refused while the Patients app is disabled.
A budget cannot be sent by email when the patient has no email address.
Budget items cannot be created or copied while the treatment catalog is disabled.
A professional cannot be assigned while the Professionals app is disabled.
The selected catalog item is unavailable or does not belong to the active clinic.

errors.message: Budget status transition is not allowed
errors.description: The requested send, accept, reject, cancel, or renegotiate action is not allowed from the budget's current status.
A budget must contain at least one item before it can be sent or accepted.

errors.message: Only draft budgets can be edited
errors.description: Budget fields and items can only be changed while the budget is in draft status.

errors.message: Budget belongs to a treatment plan
errors.description: A budget linked to a treatment plan must be deleted with that plan.

errors.message: Reminders only apply to sent budgets
errors.description: A reminder can only be sent for a budget whose status is sent.
Budget generation and addendum operations require the Treatment Plans app contract.
The requested treatment plan does not exist in the active clinic.

errors.message: Plan already has a budget linked
errors.description: A primary budget cannot be generated while a live budget is already linked to the plan.

errors.message: No catalog items found in plan
errors.description: A budget can be generated from a plan only when it contains treatments linked to catalog items.

errors.message: Addendum requires a patient and at least one item
errors.description: An addendum cannot be created unless its plan snapshot contains a patient and one or more items.
An addendum can only be created for a plan in pending or active status.

errors.message: Every treatment in this plan is already budgeted
errors.description: No addendum can be created because all plan treatments already have budget items.
The public-link verification method must match the method configured for the budget.
A valid token-scoped verification session is required to access this public budget.
The submitted verification value is invalid or uses a method that does not match the configured method.
The public token was locked after repeated failed verification attempts or by a staff action.
The budget is past its validity date and cannot be accessed or decided through the public link.
The public-link verification attempt limit has been reached; retry after the rate-limit window.
An accepted or rejected budget cannot be accepted or rejected again through its public link.
A public rejection reason must be one of the supported options: price, time, second_opinion, or other.

errors.message: Manual code must be 4-6 numeric digits
errors.description: A manual verification code must contain 4 to 6 digits.
Request data failed schema validation, including invalid amounts, quantities, discounts, signatures, status filters, or unsupported locales.
A budget operation failed a domain validation rule.
